# agent-manifest-lint

> Lint agent manifests for least privilege: required fields, wildcard and sensitive permissions, tool permissions not declared, unused grants and inline secrets, with JSON pointers Python package `trysac-agent-manifest-lint`, import name `agent_manifest_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
